scripts.build: cd packages/chord && pnpm run build && cd ../tui && pnpm run build && cd ../telemetry && pnpm run build && cd ../ai && pnpm run build && cd ../agent && pnpm run build && cd ../session-backends/sqlite-node && pnpm run build && cd ../../protocol && pnpm run build && cd ../client && pnpm run build && cd ../server && pnpm run build && cd ../coding-agent && pnpm run build
scripts.build:offline: cd packages/chord && pnpm run build && cd ../tui && pnpm run build && cd ../telemetry && pnpm run build && cd ../ai && pnpm run build:offline && cd ../agent && pnpm run build && cd ../session-backends/sqlite-node && pnpm run build && cd ../../protocol && pnpm run build && cd ../client && pnpm run build && cd ../server && pnpm run build && cd ../coding-agent && pnpm run build
scripts.check: biome check --write --error-on-warnings . && pnpm run check:pinned-deps && pnpm run check:runtime-deps && pnpm run check:ts-imports && pnpm run check:entry-graphs && pnpm run check:shrinkwrap && pnpm run check:install-lock:coding-agent && tsgo --noEmit && pnpm run check:browser-smoke
scripts.generate:models: pnpm --dir packages/ai run generate-models && pnpm --dir packages/ai run generate-image-models
scripts.test: pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm -r --if-present run test
scripts.version:patch: pnpm -r version patch --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && pnpm install --lockfile-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.version:minor: pnpm -r version minor --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && pnpm install --lockfile-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.version:major: pnpm -r version major --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && pnpm install --lockfile-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build && pnpm run check
